text:
morgan: Quick idea — instead of a big schema backfill for console telemetry, propose a "schema stencil" layer. lightweight per-route mapping that materializes only the columns dashboards actually query. avoids large backfills and lets us evolve envelope shape more safely. sketch attached (link).
priya: Curious. How does stencil differ from our current denorm/dual-write approach?
sam: tl;dr: stencil = compact mapping + versioning. Store raw envelope in blob + stencil_version on route. Reconciler materializes columns on demand. No immediate backfill of historical rows.
eli: sounds promising if queries still fast. what's the perf cost of on-read mapping vs materialized columns?
morgan: design: default stencil v1 materializes common fields (route_id, tenant_id, usage_tokens, timestamp). advanced stencils can materialize route labels, quota_group, computed cost_tier. Reconciler does async shadow-write to materialized table for routes opting in.
priya: can we show a minimal migration plan? I worry about dashboards that depend on p99 by region — needs backfilled column.
morgan: minimal plan: 1) add stencil_version int default 1 to route_profiles 2) add analytics.materialized_v{n} table (schema stable subset) 3) start dual-write in ingest for new rows if stencil_version >= 1 4) run reconciler to backfill active route_ids with high query volume first 5) keep raw envelope for long tail and run on-read mapping for ad-hoc queries.
sam: pseudo SQL snippet:```sql
alter table route_profiles add column stencil_version int default 1;
create table analytics.materialized_v1 (
  route_id uuid,
  tenant_id uuid,
  ts timestamptz,
  usage_tokens bigint,
  cost_tier text,
  primary key (route_id, ts)
);
-- reconciler reads raw_envelope, applies stencil mapping, upserts into materialized_v1
```
eli: nice. what about quota routing? dashboards need per-route quota windows and per-tenant capacity. do we materialize quota windows too?
morgan: propose stencil rule type: simple_field, computed_window, json_path. computed_window expands to columns like quota_window_start, quota_window_size, quota_used. can be materialized selectively.
infra-bot: note: reconciler job memory peak ~4GB in staging during initial test, will need batching knobs. :warning:
priya: fallback UX for rollouts — dashboards should show a small banner when a route is served from raw_envelope (on-read) vs materialized table. product ok with banner?
eli: yes, but keep UX subtle. also need a flag in console to request a manual backfill for a route.
morgan: action items: - morgan: open RFC with stencil spec + mapping DSL - sam: prototype reconciler that supports per-route batching + canary run - infra: add reconciler memory caps and metric hooks - priya: mock banner and manual backfill button in console
sam: canary target: 10 high-volume internal routes. will capture latency/ingest cost delta.
deploy-bot: reconciler-canary job triggered for env=staging, job id #2026, started 03:12UTC.
eli: ok — schedule 30 minute sync tomorrow to review canary results. :calendar:
